# Cheche Za Nuru Foundation

> Cheche Za Nuru Foundation helps children in Kibera, Nairobi stay in school, stay healthy and play sport, through scholarships, clinic care, a feeding programme and a youth football club.

Cheche za nuru is Swahili for "sparks of light". The foundation was founded by Rene Roby and works with families in Kibera.

## Programmes

- Nuru Scholars: school scholarships.
- Afya Kwa Wote: community health outreach and clinic care.
- Rising Stars: a youth sports league and football club.

## Ways to Help

- Donate once or monthly, and choose which programme the gift goes to.
- Volunteer as a mentor, clinician or coach.
- Partner with the foundation.
